config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.anth]
dialect = "anthropic"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
count_tokens = true

[[models]]
name = "claude-haiku"
provider = "anth"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
name: count_tokens_passthrough
